topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text: Hey, I just heard about the condo thing, and honestly, I think it’s a solid change. I mean, yeah, it’s a shift, but think about it—more control over your space, maybe even some upgrades, and you get to really make it yours. Plus, it could be a great investment. I know it feels sudden, but changes like these open up opportunities, right? I see how well you handle things, and I’m sure you’ll make the most of it. Let’s grab coffee and hash out all the possibilities. Can’t wait to hear your thoughts!
